name: Meeting Report
description: A formal, shareable report of a meeting's purpose, outcomes, decisions, actions and risks.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.instruction: State in one or two sentences why the meeting was held, as it appears from the discussion.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.instruction: Summarise the outcome of the meeting in one paragraph for a reader who was not there.

sections.title: Key Outcomes
sections.instruction: List the main results and conclusions, each with [mm:ss].

sections.title: Actions
sections.instruction: List each action. Fill owner and due date only when they were stated in the meeting; otherwise write 'Not stated'.

sections.title: Risks and Open Issues
sections.instruction: List risks, concerns, blockers and unresolved questions raised, with [mm:ss]. Write 'None raised' if there were none.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Describe what happens next, as agreed in the meeting.
